title: a flow condition passes timestamp(record.<date field>) while the same call over the bare name is refused: record.FIELD reads are not typed for the date-text verdicts there
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQAXHSQEgnYyx9tstb

Filing gate: ① measured. Out-of-scope finding of the #34451 dev round (PR #34654), reproduced by the area. ⛔ Not a claim.

Suggested-grade: p2 — the same family and outcome as #34363 / #34451: the flow fails on every run and nothing is said at authoring time.

## What

In a flow condition (the flattened scope: start, edge and `decision` conditions), the date-text check types a bare field name but not a `record.<field>` read. A record-triggered flow whose start condition is `timestamp(record.borrow_date) < now()` (`borrow_date` a `date` field) gets zero findings from `validateStackExpressions` and fails every run, because the runtime holds a date field as its `YYYY-MM-DD` text, which `timestamp()` does not parse. The same comparison over the bare name is refused.

## Measured

Probe over `validateStackExpressions` from the `@objectstack/lint` dist built on PR #34654's head `20c39a477f` (that PR does not touch flow conditions), object `library_loan` with `borrow_date: date`, `picked_up_at: datetime`, start node `objectName: library_loan`, `triggerType: record-after-update`:

| start condition | findings |
|:---|:---|
| `timestamp(record.borrow_date) < now()` | 0 |
| `timestamp(borrow_date) < now()` | 1 error (date-text-call, names `borrow_date` as a date field) |
| `timestamp(record.picked_up_at) < now()` (CONTROL) | 0 |

## Where

`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: the date-text check (`dateTextIssue` / `dateTextCallIssue`) at the flattened scope types bare names; the `record.` / `previous.` roots there are not handed the field types for this family.

## Done when

`timestamp(record.<date field>)` in a flow condition is refused like its bare-name spelling, at `os validate` and at the flow publish door; CONTROL: a `datetime` field stays clean.

Related: #34363, #34447, #34451 (same verdict family).

Dedupe words: flow condition record root date-text, timestamp record date field flattened, firstDateTextCall recordRootTypes.
